notes_for_editor: Thin station: no annual-report narrative or newspapers read. Parks Canada's DFHD page would not load; its text was read via Heritage Guide and HistoricPlaces 25235. Lighthouse Friends gives tower height 3.7 m, PEILS also says '21 feet' in one line but 12 ft elsewhere. Registers 20482 (provincial) calls the 1903 tower 'current' and says the light was moved to its current location; PEILS says private property while Lighthouse Friends says Coast Guard owned: ownership unclear. Record's rear light details not researched. The 1910-11 report salary row ($130) was matched by position in OCR, check the page image; story cites printed p.253 per corpus label. Lighthouse Friends text for the 15 June 1894 date: it says 'first activated June 15, 1894' while Wright's appointment is 14 June. Fact-check 2026-10-27: 1910-11 salary row ($130, Wrights Range, Charles Wright, June 14 1894) confirmed on page image, printed p.253, PEI table. Ownership (Society: private property; LF: Coast Guard) now stated as a disagreement in the story. PEILS 'Q red' etc. not used in story.
